reviews.comment:
Siempre paramos ahí de camino a Rosario. Es amplio cómodo y tiene juegos para los chicos. Pero algo super negativo, si llegas tipo 21;40 no podés comer !!!! Cierran la cocina y no hacen nada por quién viene de manejar por horas. Cierra el shop a las 22!!! malísimo, debería estar al menos hasta las 24 . Más siendo del ACA. Como socia me siento decepcionada.

(Translated by Google)
We always stop there on our way to Rosario. It's spacious, comfortable, and has a play area for kids. But one major drawback is that if you arrive around 9:40 PM, you can't get anything to eat! They close the kitchen and do nothing for those who have driven for hours. The shop closes at 10 PM! Terrible; it should be open at least until midnight, especially since it's an ACA (Automobile Club of Argentina) location. As a member, I'm very disappointed.
